headline: EMC crashes 50.00% intraday as volume dries, while PF PROP surges 25.00% on strong buying

Property and construction saw strong upside in PF (+25.00%) and RML (+25.00%) alongside notable volume, while BLAND slipped 8.45% despite heavy trading. Food names posted solid gains and several filings, and CONMAT highlighted strategic moves into smart‑toilet manufacturing.
